payload.title: Falsify TTL-only single-presence against live-but-expired holder overlap
payload.work_clay: On the accepted one-host Ubuntu target, run a two-process discriminator against the current canonical frank_presence_runtime V15. Process A acquires the Frank presence lease, remains alive and deliberately stops heartbeating while continuing a bounded inert cognition-loop surrogate past expires_at. Process B attempts acquisition after expiry. Measure whether both processes can remain execution-capable concurrently. Repeat with every consequential action/effect boundary fenced by current lease_epoch. Compare current SQLite TTL+fencing baseline against a minimal Linux exclusive flock held for the whole active execution plus short UnifiedDB transactions/generation receipts. Preserve process IDs, monotonic timing, lease epochs, DB rows, CPU/RAM, overlap interval, crash/restart behavior and exact source/build hashes. Do not promote the physical-lock candidate unless it eliminates overlap without unacceptable recovery/latency cost.
payload.hypothesis: Current V15 lease_epoch fencing is sufficient only if every continuing cognition/tool/effect path revalidates the active epoch before acting; otherwise a live-but-expired holder can overlap a successor.
payload.strongest_counterhypothesis: The existing heartbeat/expiry/fencing discipline already guarantees effective single-active Frank because all material execution paths are or will be epoch-gated; an OS flock adds no measurable safety and only harms recovery/composability.
payload.cheapest_discriminator: Two real Linux processes; A stays alive past TTL without heartbeat, B acquires after expiry; record concurrent execution window and attempt a harmless fenced state/effect surrogate from A after B owns the newer epoch.
acceptance: exactly one execution-capable Frank holder under declared semantics
stale holder cannot perform admitted state mutation or consequential effect
crash recovery returns to availability without manual DB repair
no raw token or active caller secret leaks
invalidators: A newer current-source target receipt already executes this exact live-holder overlap matrix
Target becomes multi-host before this one-host discriminator executes
